text:
maria_sales: Quick one — OctaCare wants a 4-week POC. Requirements: agent in their VPC, preserve client source IPs for logs, strictly allow outbound only to our endpoints (443 and 9000). Also want a one-line POC pricing blurb for procurement.

sam_neteng: Peering preserves src IPs if routes point at our peered subnets. PrivateLink is easier for firewall rules but often needs NAT. Recommend peering as primary + PrivateLink fallback.

anya_solutions: Short checklist to hand to their netops:
1) Confirm CIDR non-overlap (customer example 10.50.0.0/16)
2) Create & accept VPC peering with our account
3) Add route to our peered subnet (10.210.5.0/24)
4) SGs: allow outbound tcp 443,9000 to 10.210.5.0/24
5) Test: curl echo endpoint and check X-Client-IP header

lee_security: Security notes: we support SPKI cert pinning (we'll provide fingerprints), logs with client IPs can be forwarded to customer SIEM, and for Hosted fallback retention defaults to 30 days unless requested otherwise.

maria_sales: Procurement SOW blurbs (non-binding) please:
- Peering + Dedicated: "Reserved capacity fee (monthly) + nominal network egress; recommended for src-IP logging and predictable latency."
- Hosted + PrivateLink (fallback): "Pay-as-you-go per token + interface endpoint transfer; faster onboarding, good as backup."

sam_neteng: Minimal SG snippet for PrivateLink fallback:
```
# allow to our interface endpoint
allow tcp from 10.50.0.0/16 to eni-aaaa1111 port 443
allow tcp from 10.50.0.0/16 to eni-aaaa1111 port 9000
```

incidents-bot: runbook:create peering-fallback-test queued by sam_neteng — ETA 2h :gear: 

maria_sales: Great — can we get runbook + SG snippets + SOW blurbs uploaded by EOD? OctaCare wants to sign after legal review on Friday.

anya_solutions: Will upload runbook and a 1-page options table (peering vs privatelink vs proxy) in this thread later today.

lee_security: I'll attach SOC2 pointer and cert pinning fingerprints in the runbook.

maria_sales: Thanks team.
